abstract: The effect of synthetic luteinizing hormone-releasing factor (LRF) on release of human chorionic gonadotrophin (hCG) was studied by isolated cell columns of normal syncytiotrophoblasts and choriocarcinoma (BeWo) cells. After LRF stimulation the release of hCG by the normal trophoblasts increased up to 4-fold and release by the malignant trophoblasts increased up to 6-fold, indicating a specific effect of LRF on normal and malignant trophoblast cells.
abstract_ja: 正常な栄養膜合胞体細胞と絨毛癌(BeWo)細胞の単離細胞カラムを用いて、合成黄体形成ホルモン放出因子(LRF)がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)放出に与える影響を検討した。LRF刺激後、正常栄養膜細胞におけるhCG放出は最大4倍、悪性栄養膜細胞では最大6倍に増加し、LRFが正常および悪性栄養膜細胞に特異的に作用することが示された。
